source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting results that contradict the hypothesis in a psychology research report

1. Start with the research records.
2.
completion:
Make an honest record of your analysis.
3. Focus on the scientific process.
4. Use neutral language
5. Explain potential reasons for the unexpected results.
6. Discuss limitations
7. Suggest future research.
8. Be thorough and detailed.
9. Reliability and Validity
10. Submit results for peer review.

For more information, see: [https://www.simplypsychology.org/research-results-contradict-hypothesis.html](https://www.simplypsychology.org/research-results-contradict-hypothesis.html)<end_of_turn>
